marketday.quest.butcher_order.title: Market Order: %1$s
marketday.quest.butcher_order.offer: Market day tomorrow and my counter is bare. Bring me %1$s of the %2$s, %3$s, and I will pay properly.
marketday.quest.butcher_order.accept: Good. Wrapped and cold, if you can manage it.
marketday.quest.butcher_order.decline: Then it is bread and regret for the whole square.
marketday.quest.butcher_order.ready: That is the counter filled. Come round the back.
marketday.quest.butcher_order.complete: Here — %1$s emeralds, and the first cut of the morning.
marketday.quest.mason_haul.title: Stone Order: %1$s
marketday.quest.mason_haul.offer: I am short of %1$s. Cut me %2$s blocks of it and the wall gets finished before the frost.
marketday.quest.mason_haul.accept: Take a good pick. The cheap ones shatter.
marketday.quest.mason_haul.decline: The wall waits. It always waits.
marketday.quest.mason_haul.ready: That is the load. Tip it by the scaffold.
marketday.quest.mason_haul.complete: Now that is stone worth laying. My thanks.
marketday.quest.ranger_cull.title: Bounty: %1$s
marketday.quest.ranger_cull.offer: The market road is not safe. %1$s of the %2$s, and take the reward from the strongbox.
marketday.quest.ranger_cull.accept: Keep to the lantern line and you will find them.
marketday.quest.ranger_cull.decline: Then we post a double watch and lose the sleep.
marketday.quest.ranger_cull.in_progress: Still %1$s out there, by the sound of it.
marketday.quest.ranger_cull.ready: The road is quiet again. I heard it stop.
marketday.quest.ranger_cull.complete: Traders will sleep tonight. So will I.
marketday.quest.wanderer_route.title: Route Survey: %1$s
marketday.quest.wanderer_route.offer: I am drawing the trade routes wider. See the %1$s for yourself, and set foot in %2$s while you are about it — %3$s.
marketday.quest.wanderer_route.accept: Walk it, do not guess it. Guessed maps kill people.
marketday.quest.wanderer_route.decline: Then the map keeps its blank edge a while longer.
marketday.quest.wanderer_route.in_progre: Have you laid eyes on the %1$s yet?
marketday.quest.wanderer_route.ready: You have been. I can tell by the boots.
marketday.quest.wanderer_route.complete: The route is real now. Somebody will get rich on this.
marketday.flavor.rumour.tall_tale: though I only half believe the stories
marketday.flavor.rumour.old_map: there is an old chart that disagrees with me
